message: Your design is bigger than the hoop, so the machine cannot sew all of it. Pick a bigger hoop or shrink the design.

fix.label: Pick the smallest hoop that fits

message: Some spots have too many stitches close together. Thread may break or the cloth may pucker. Loosen the spacing.
Some stitches were longer than 12 mm, so Lilo split them. The file is safe, but a tighter fill pattern looks neater.
A shape made no stitches. Check that it has a thread and a real size.
This design has many colour changes. Each one is a stop to swap thread. Group or merge close colours.
This is a big design, over 30,000 stitches. Expect a long sew and a large file.
This will take over an hour to sew at a normal machine speed. Plan for it, or make the design smaller.
Some filled shapes are under 1 mm wide. That is too small to sew clean. Remove them or make them bigger.
A satin column is wider than 8 mm. Long stitches can snag. Turn on splitting so it sews in two halves.
Your letters are too small to sew clean with this thread. Make them taller, or switch to finer 60 wt thread.
